chapter: Gil Evans, Birth of the Cool and the Second Herd
title: Carisi's Israel and Woody's taste
summary: They discuss John Carisi's Israel, written first for Woody's band, which Mandel says did not suit Herman.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: Supposedly John Carisi originally wrote, “Israel,” for that band.
He did? I didn’t know that.
That’s what he said, in Gitler’s book as a matter of fact. Apparently they never…
It would not have fit that band at all.
They never played it, so he rewrote it for the, Birth of the Cool band.
I mean it was wonderful anyway but it wasn’t the kind of thing Woody was into, he was into much more of a straight swinging kind of thing. Mulligan was writing more
